found_by: the in-process fuzzer, read-write mode, during the first fuzz interlude of a soak -- two minutes of campaign time produced two crashes at this site and three other artifacts
base: Tests/fuzz/make_seeds.sh seed s06 (ext4, 1 KiB blocks, metadata_csum, unreplayed journal, 4 MiB)
minimization: delta-debugged against the seed: 20 bytes in 13 runs
symptom: ext4_dir_try_insert_entry walked a directory block using each entry's rec_len without bounding it. The free-entry path passes rec_len to ext4_dir_write_entry, which asserts entry_len <= block_size; the split path computes rec_len - sz in uint16 arithmetic and wraps; and the loop advances by rec_len, so zero spins forever while the driver holds the mount. lwext4 assertion failed at ext4_dir.c:304, reached from ext4_dir_add_entry -- a create, on a read-write mount.
reproduce: build/bin/ext4dump script - with a mkdir and a create
